extraction.Name: Lizzie Guerue Two Horse
extraction.Refused/Protested: No, but I was under the impression that I had to take it because it had been issued to me.
extraction.Occupation/Income: house keeper at the Government jail at Rosebud
extraction.NOTES: Husband is chief of police at Rosebud; together husband and wife advertised their land for sale to the highest bidder after receiving patents and together got $9065.00; allottee received $3565.00 in cash for her land; three children depend on allottee and husband for support; delivered by mail; document number 10662; notarized June 26, 1929 by Cas. W. Cross, Notary Public, commission expires 4-28-32.
